name: Timothy Riari
original_name: ティモシー・リアリー
source:
A young boy who Georik takes in as a servant. He is skilled in alchemy, and teaches Georik about it.

"...is an enigma wrapped in a mystery wrapped in something that looks an awful lot like lederhosen. Despite his tender years, he is apparently an experienced alchemist. COULD HE POSSIBLY BE MORE THAN WHAT HE SEEMS!?!?!?"

[Based on [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20061018090801/http://community.hirameki-int.com/modules/charpoll5/index.php?id=1]Hirameki's Official Site[/url] (Website is via webarchive)]
